hero.headline: Material recognition for household plastic
hero.subtext: Our AI judges whether a piece of plastic waste can go into pyrolysis, so mixed and dirty household plastic that mechanical recycling rejects becomes recycled feedstock instead of being incinerated.

home.erpDesc: Asper builds and runs ERP and CRM systems for factories. At our affiliate's pyrolysis plant, employees use them every day: the ERP for attendance, scheduling, and payroll, and the CRM for customers and sample orders.
home.esgDesc: Next, we will turn the photo and timestamp behind every judgment into the data companies need for waste-reduction and ESG reporting.
